scope: GeoFrame-forward encoder research and its diagnostic/downstream evaluations. Hardware/simulation/cache inventories excluded. Raw records are evidence, not independently ranked fits.

families.title: GeoFrame / GeoFrame V2 (GeoFormer in discussion)
families.description: Canonical patch frames, invariant transformer; VICReg/VISReg and FactorVAE variants.

families.title: GeoFrame shooting and predictive-atlas studies
families.description: Frozen descriptors, causal history states and limited encoder fine-tuning; distinguish fitted heads from encoder changes.

families.title: Continuous density, SchNet and reference MACE
families.description: Scratch continuous-geometry controls, fixed physical tasks and temporal predictive objectives.

families.title: Pretrained scalar MACE
families.description: MLIP initialization; spatial/temporal VICReg, TDA, denoising and pooled/atom temporal fusion.

families.title: Complete-context and dual-readout MACE
families.description: Smooth inner support, full computational halo, tracked-center/inner features and physical supervision.

families.title: Coordinate/velocity MACE
families.description: 256 structural, 32 activity and 16 directed-motion channels; native fine-tuning.

families.title: Discarded frozen-feature replacement maps
families.description: PCA/physical/temporal maps and slowness/curvature/motion objectives; backbone remains frozen.

families.title: Native causal MACE
families.description: Trainable atom-level scalar/vector/tensor geometry, velocity and history before pooling.

families.title: Partial-observation predictive memory
families.description: Native causal state and fixed multi-lag physical-path density prediction.

families.title: Local predictability and physical backbones
families.description: Descriptor baselines and raw MACE/GATr recognition, onset and future-physical supervision.

families.title: Shared structural MACE / GATr
families.description: VICReg/JEPA/SIGReg with physical/TDA anchors; stable/local/bond-order/expanded-data revisions.

families.title: Equivariant neighborhood JEPA
families.description: Snapshot MACE trained with spatial/temporal latent prediction and fixed physical anchors; v1/v2/regularizer/multihorizon variants.

families.title: Observed/relaxed encoder comparisons
families.description: Paired hot/hot, hot/cold, cold/cold reconstruction and conditional regularization.

families.title: Bottleneck-conditioned reconstruction
families.description: Clean invariant encoder code conditions a noisy-geometry denoiser; conditioning and fresh-decoder controls.

families.title: Fixed structural-state MACE
families.description: Geometry reconstruction, relaxed teachers and distance supervision; repaired v2 and distance/future factorial.

families.title: Frozen-encoder forecasting and context
families.description: Downstream direct/AR/mixture/diffusion/context predictors; these are not new encoder fits.

families.title: Cross-encoder information and visualization audits
families.description: Topology, geometry, conditional information, invariance, spatial plots and trajectory stability.

families.title: Earlier registered controls
families.description: Historical PointNet/VN/DGCNN/other sweeps where artifacts exist; outside the GeoFrame-forward main narrative.
